items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: I did a lot of soap operas, what was the Irish one there, “Ryan’s Hope.”

ctx.x: Okay but do you get some mysterious checks sometimes?

Yeah, yeah, yeah. Well I mean I did a lot of soap operas, what was the Irish one there, “Ryan’s Hope.” And they released all the stuff that I was on and they played them all again. I made a lot of money.
Nice. It’s nice when the system works like that right?
